correctness.rationale: Automorphism-averaged lower bound using odd two-dimensional invariant block, monotonicity in bridge probability, and strictly convex scalar minimization establishes rho(P)>=rho*. A fully specified feasible symmetric stochastic matrix has complete eigenvalue list bounded in modulus by rho* and attains it. Standalone replay supplies 437 parameter cases, 67 full matrix decompositions and 8405 finite comparison checks; finite experiments are only supplementary.

originality.rationale: Searches of indexed mathematical findings, accessible prior-claim ledgers and relevant primary literature uncovered no result implying the exact two-parameter SLEM and optimal supported symmetric kernel. Boyd 2004/2009 supplies optimization and symmetry tools; Allison–Shader 2011 overlaps cliques rather than linking disjoint cliques; Olesker-Taylor–Zanetti addresses a full matching (k=m) and only rate order; Jafarizadeh handles single-edge barbells and general clique-lifts, not this partial-matching equality case. Unindexed equivalent claims and inaccessible full text remain explicit risks.

value.rationale: A two-parameter infinite family of dense communities joined through sparse matched gateways has a globally exact optimal symmetric Markov mixing rate, all constructive weights, a sharp bridge-density dependence and optimal omission of unused intra-gateway links. This exact bottleneck optimization is mathematically motivated and not a simple instantiation of a supplied numerical rate table.
